description: Lists the retailer offers WEM's catalogue holds for one product, current prices first and each group cheapest first, with WEM's 90-day price low (null when the product is held only in another currency). The product is found by barcode, catalogue slug or wem3.ai/pl/ URL, WEM ID, or a title (a model name, ASIN, MPN or merchant SKU) that must pass a relevance check; there is no live retailer search. A barcode, slug or WEM ID match is the product itself; a title match is inferred and marked so in `identity`. A marketplace offer priced far below the product's other offers is withheld and counted in `filtered`. When WEM does not hold the product, `found` is false and `nextTool` names search_products with a query.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the shopper's market. Default GBP. Decides which market's offers WEM returns from its catalogue, not just how the answer reads ; WEM does not infer the market from IP. When WEM holds the product only in another currency it says so rather than presenting a foreign listing as the answer.

gtin.description: Product barcode: EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8 or GTIN-14. The strongest identifier.

slug.description: WEM catalogue slug, or a wem3.ai/pl/{slug} URL / host path. Hosts may pass either form.

title.description: Product or model name, or an ASIN, MPN or merchant SKU (e.g. AF400UK). The weakest identifier: used only when no barcode, slug or WEM ID is given, and only if it passes a relevance check; otherwise `found` is false rather than a guess.

wem_id.description: WEM ID (W + 10 Crockford characters + check). Active catalogue products only.

name: compare_offers

outputSchema.description: The retailer offers WEM holds for one catalogue product, current prices first and each group cheapest first. When `found` is false WEM simply does not hold this product yet — that is a normal answer, not a failure, and it says nothing about whether the product exists or what it costs. `nextTool` then names `search_products` and the query. An empty catalogue result is not a statement that the product is unavailable or unpriced.

coverage.description: Present when surviving rows include a marketplace cluster at similar prices. That is not a retail floor — the cheapest marketplace listing is not the deal. The listings stay in the payload, each with its url. `next`, when present, is the Chrome extension page for shops WEM does not yet hold as partners.

provider.description: ebay, aliexpress, or marketplace when mixed.

degraded.description: Present when this call hit its time budget and skipped enrichment. The offers returned are COMPLETE — only the extras were dropped. A missing catalogue block or missing observed retailers does not mean WEM holds nothing, and no retry is needed.

disclosure.description: WEM’s affiliate disclosure for this answer, written to be quoted as it is. Its wording changes with the rows: it states whether every outbound link is affiliate-tracked, only some are, or none are. A version from an earlier answer may not fit this one: a row marked `affiliate: false` earns WEM nothing.

filtered.description: Offers of this product WEM held back, tallied by reason. "Priced far below this product’s other offers" is a marketplace listing under 40% of what the product sells for elsewhere — the shape of a counterfeit, a part or a mislisted variant. Those prices are not in `offers`, `lowPrice`, `links`, `summary` or `priceHistory.low`: none is the cheapest, a deal or the 90-day low. The tally says how many were held back.

found.description: False when the product is not in WEM’s catalogue. The rest of the fields below are then absent ; that does not mean the product is unavailable or unpriced. `unavailable` distinguishes an outage from a miss. `nextTool`, when present, names the next lookup.

highPrice.description: Highest current price in `offers`; null with lowPrice.

identity.description: How the shopper’s words reached this product. On `inferred`, WEM matched it by name (not by barcode) and the identity is not confirmed, even when `identityBasis` is `barcode`; on `exact`, the barcode itself resolved it.

strength.description: exact = barcode; catalogued = a WEM key or listing id; inferred = matched on the product name, MPN or SKU and still a guess.

identityBasis.description: How this product’s offers are grouped — NOT how the shopper’s words found the product; that is `identity`. `barcode`: the product carries a GTIN, so every offer here is that same item. `curated-grouping`: it carries none, and the grouping is an inference. This field does not make a result a barcode match: when `identity.strength` is `inferred`, WEM matched the product by name.

lastConfirmedAt.description: When WEM last actually read any price in this answer. Null means none of them can be dated, so the answer is not current.

links.description: The links from `offers`, cheapest first, pre-formatted. Each opens the retailer’s page for the offer WEM priced; a retailer URL found elsewhere may be a different listing or price. The same links are in this array and, when a host renders one, in the card.

markdown.description: The same link as `[Retailer — £0.00](url)`, for hosts rendering markdown.

price.description: Null for a listing in `unpriced`. The markdown says "see price at Amazon" in place of a figure.

url.description: WEM tracked redirect. The full URL; a shortened or rewritten form is a different link.

lowPrice.description: Lowest CURRENT price in `offers` (read within 14 days). Null when no price is current or WEM holds none it may quote ; it is never taken from a stale or undated row, or from `unpriced`.

next.description: Present when WEM's set of offers is thin. chrome_extension is a page that compares the same product on any retailer page, including shops without an affiliate programme.

nextTool.description: Present only when `found` is false. It names `search_products` and the query. A named model that misses the catalogue is the ordinary case.

offers.description: Current prices first (`priceStatus`), each group ascending by price; a stale or undated row is listed, never compared. Barcode, slug and WEM ID rows are the product. A title match is inferred; `identity.strength` says which.

affiliate.description: False when this link earns WEM nothing: the shop has no affiliate programme with WEM, or this link does not carry one. It is still a real offer, and its link is not affiliate-tracked. Absent (or true) means the link is affiliate-tracked. `disclosure` states whether all, some or none of the links are tracked.

channel.description: retailer is a named shop (Boots, Currys). marketplace is eBay/AliExpress/Temu-style parallel listings. A marketplace cluster is not a set of competing authorised retailers.

lastSeenAt.description: When WEM last READ this price from the retailer or a datafeed — the same reading `priceAgeDays` counts from, so the two always agree. Null means WEM cannot date the price: it is undated, not current.

price.description: Indicative price. The retailer sets the final price at checkout. Null, with `priceNote`, when WEM may not show this listing’s price: the note stands in place of a figure.

priceAgeDays.description: Calendar days (UK time) since WEM last READ this price: 0 read today, 1 yesterday. Null means WEM cannot say. Null is undated, not current.

priceNote.description: Present only when `price` is null: the words that stand in its place, e.g. "See price at Amazon". An Amazon price is shown only when Amazon’s API supplied it just now.

priceQualifier.description: Present when `price` is the OPENING price of a range, not the price of this item: a multi-variation listing where the seller advertises its cheapest variant and the shopper picks a size on the page. It reads as "from £X"; it is not the item's price or the cheapest. Absent means the price is firm for the row as described.

priceRefresh.description: What re-reads this retailer’s prices: `live-api` a product-lookup API, `feed` a partner datafeed, `none` nothing on a schedule. `none` means the figure will not move on its own however long it sits ; `priceAgeDays` dates it.

priceStatus.description: `current`: WEM read this price within the last 14 days; only a current price may lead, be called the cheapest or lowest, be compared or enter a saving. `stale`: read longer ago. `undated`: WEM cannot say when. Those two read as "last seen £X on 8 Sep" or "price not dated", come after the current ones, and are not compared. Absent on a row a provider answered just now.

shipping.description: Delivery as the retailer stated it: `free`, or `cost` in the offer currency. Absent or null means not stated: say delivery is shown at the shop, never that it is free. Offers are ordered by item price; add a stated cost before calling one cheaper delivered.

estimate.description: Delivery window when the feed stated one.

unitPrice.description: Price per 100ml, 100g, litre, kg or item, from the size this row's title states. Present only when the rows differ in size, in one unit across all of them, and only for things bought by the amount (beauty, food, supplements), never an appliance's capacity. Across sizes, value is compared on these, not on the prices: a smaller size is not cheaper because its price is lower. It reads beside the price ("£29.95, £99.83 per 100ml"). Absent does not mean the price is per unit.

url.description: WEM tracked link to the retailer page for this offer. WEM never takes payment.

priceHistory.description: The 90-day low, for telling a real discount from a repackaged one.

gtin.description: The barcode identity was resolved on.

image.description: Product photo, served from wem3.ai. Null when none is available.

wem_id.description: WEM ID of this active product. Null when unknown.

ranking.description: Why the offers are in this order. Offers are ordered by price, lowest first; affiliate commission is not an input.

reason.description: Present only when `found` is false: which identifier missed, and why. When `unavailable` is true this describes the outage rather than a missing product ; it is the reason the lookup failed, not a fact about the product.

sameModel.description: Present only when the maker's own page says another model code is this product and a person at WEM has checked it. These are NOT offers for the product asked about: they are not part of `offers`, and none is this product's lowest price or the best deal. On verify_offer they are not part of the check: `verdict`, `cheapest`, `betterBy`, `summary` and the receipt are about the product asked about, and a cheaper sister code never makes the claimed price wrong. `summary` is written to be quoted as it is. `maker.host` is the source of the claim. `url` is WEM's comparison for that model, not a shop. When `relation` is `differs`, the `differences` are what the maker says differs, and its price is not a saving. Absent is not evidence that no equivalent exists.

cheapest.description: The other model's cheapest named shop. Null when no named shop has an in-stock price for it. `priceAgeDays` gives its age; without one it is not current.

priceAgeDays.description: Days since WEM read that price. Null means undated.

checkedOn.description: When a person at WEM read the maker’s page (YYYY-MM-DD).

differences.description: What the maker says differs. Empty when identical.

maker.description: The maker's own page that says so: the proof. WEM is not the source of the claim.

model.description: The other model code, as the maker writes it.

relation.description: `identical`: the maker says it is the same product. `differs`: the same product except `differences`; not like for like.

summary.description: WEM’s words for it, written to be quoted as they are.

url.description: WEM's comparison for that model, not a shop.

search.description: Present when this result names no offer. `url` is WEM's results page for the query and `markdown` is the same link, pre-formatted. This tool reads the catalogue only, so an empty result here is not evidence the product is unavailable or unpriced.

unavailable.description: Present and true only when WEM could not reach its catalogue at all. `found` is false for the same reason it is on an ordinary miss, so the two are indistinguishable without this flag. When it is set, WEM does not know whether it holds the product. The lookup could not be completed; it does not mean WEM has no offers or no price for it. `nextTool` is still present.

unpriced.description: Listings whose price WEM may not show — today, Amazon rows Amazon’s API did not price just now. The row carries `priceNote` (e.g. "See price at Amazon") in place of a figure. No price is stated, estimated or compared for one; it is not the cheapest and is not counted in a lowest price or a saving.

priceNote.description: What stands where a price would be, e.g. "See price at Amazon".

url.description: WEM tracked link. The full URL; a shortened form is a different link.

title: Compare retailer offers for one product
